The [[Chest of Wintersday Past]] will spawn at the end of the [[Secret Lair of the Snowmen]] dungeon, when the party has taken [[Koris Deeprunner]] to the final room and his monologue has played out. Each player in the party may open the chest and will receive one [[Snowman Summoner]] (two in [[hard mode]]) and one other item from the drop list in [[normal mode]] (two in hard mode).   After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and players will be transported back to [[Umbral Grotto]] after three minutes.
